basic_details.short_information: One post of Teaching Associate in the Department of Entomology is to be filled by a walk-in interview at Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri, a college of Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), on 7 December 2026 from 10.00 AM. Candidates must register their names before 09.30 AM at the Office of the Associate Dean of the college, with the filled-in application form, all original certificates and one set of photocopies. The engagement is purely temporary and on a contractual basis for a period not exceeding 11 months.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The application form asks for the age as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice does not mention any other age relaxation.

selection_process: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 from 10.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College

after registration before 09.30 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the position will be final and binding in all respects. The selected candidate will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense
to ensure physical fitness before appointment.
how_to_apply: This is a walk-in recruitment, so no application is sent in advance by post or email. Candidates apply in person on the interview day.

Fill in the application form printed with the notice (pages 3 and 4): name, date of birth, age as on the date of the walk-in interview, social category, educational qualifications (Ph.D., Masters, Under Graduation, any other, with year of passing, OGPA and college and university), experience in chronological order from the latest, details of publications, books and book chapters, conferences and trainings attended, and contact details.
Sign the declaration in the form, which states that you accept the terms and conditions of the engagement.
Report on 7 December 2026 and register your name before 09.30 AM at the Office of Associate Dean, Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri.
Hand in the filled-in application along with all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and other relevant documents.
Attend the interview, which starts at 10.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri.
important_instructions: The incumbent shall not have any claim or right to claim any regular appointment in the university or any government organization. The incumbent shall not have any claim or right for further continuation of the contractual service. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection, or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice; otherwise one month's salary is to be paid before leaving. No T.A. and D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean of the college has the right to cancel or postpone the interview for the position on the said date due to unavoidable circumstances.

content_sections.heading: About ANGRAU
content_sections.text: Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) is an agricultural university, and Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College at Udayagiri, SPSR Nellore (Dt.) - 524 226, is one of its colleges. The walk-in notice is issued by the Associate Dean of the college, and the Teaching Associate post is in the college's Department of Entomology.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Apply
content_sections.text: This is a walk-in recruitment, so no application is sent in advance by post or email. Candidates apply in person on the interview day. Fill in the application form printed with the notice (pages 3 and 4): name, date of birth, age as on the date of the walk-in interview, social category, educational qualifications (Ph.D., Masters, Under Graduation, any other, with year of passing, OGPA and college and university), experience in chronological order from the latest, details of publications, books and book chapters, conferences and trainings attended, and contact details. Sign the declaration in the form, which states that you accept the terms and conditions of the engagement. Report on 7 December 2026 and register your name before 09.30 AM at the Office of Associate Dean, Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri. Hand in the filled-in application along with all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and other relevant documents. Attend the interview, which starts at 10.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for one post: Teaching Associate (01 No.), Department of Entomology. The post is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, for a period not exceeding 11 months. The notice lists the essential qualifications as follows: a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject, or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average d) Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching/ research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/ Associate ship/ Training/ other engagements e) Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals f) Candidates having a Post Graduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The application form asks for the age as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice does not mention any other age relaxation. HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders. The tenure is 11 months from the date of joining, or until the regular post is filled, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary and contractual basis and the engagement will be terminated automatically on completion of 11 months or on the filling of regular staff by the university, whichever is earlier. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form (given with the notice) All original certificates One set (photocopy) of all certificates Publications Any other relevant documents Details of trainings attended (the form asks candidates to enclose them)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 from 10.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri, after registration before 09.30 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the position will be final and binding in all respects. The selected candidate will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, to ensure physical fitness before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The incumbent shall not have any claim or right to claim any regular appointment in the university or any government organization. The incumbent shall not have any claim or right for further continuation of the contractual service. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection, or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice; otherwise one month's salary is to be paid before leaving. No T.A. and D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean of the college has the right to cancel or postpone the interview for the position on the said date due to unavoidable circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. How many Teaching Associate vacancies are there in this ANGRAU notice?
faq.answer: There is one (01 No.) Teaching Associate post in the Department of Entomology at Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026 from 10.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri; candidates must register at the Office of Associate Dean before 09.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice lists a Ph.D. or Master's Degree in the relevant subject, a 4/5-year Bachelor's Degree with first division or equivalent OGPA, at least 3 years of teaching/research experience, one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals, and NET for Basic Sciences post graduates with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 61,000/- per month plus applicable HRA for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- per month plus applicable HRA for Ph.D. Degree holders.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Teaching Associate remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, applicable HRA is paid in addition to the remuneration, at the existing State Government rates for the place, subject to change as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-in application form, all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and relevant documents, and register before 09.30 AM on 7 December 2026 at the Office of Associate Dean, SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months, ending earlier if the regular post is filled, with no claim to regular appointment or continuation.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA and DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, T.A. and D.A. will not be given to candidates appearing for the interview.
